name: cc-marketplace
description: A local Claude Code marketplace for reusable plugins.

plugins.name: github-utils
plugins.description: GitHub CLI, pull request review (with re-review and receive-pr-review workflows), issue creation, an end-to-end issue-to-fix workflow, tag-triggered release cutting, and changelog generation skills bundled as a Claude Code plugin.
